common_prompt: Use case: productivity-visual. Generate ONE complete, finished, edge-to-edge 16:9 Chinese course-defense presentation slide IMAGE, high resolution. Match reference images 1 and 2 as one coherent AgriScan presentation series: deep emerald green, warm textured gold headings, crisp ivory body text, thin jade/cyan technical light, believable botanical textures, refined dimensional details. These references are style direction, not text to copy. Image 3 is the exact 小禾 IP identity: ivory robot, deep-green face, mint eyes, two leaf sprouts and magnifier. Keep that identity whenever the character appears. National-level Chinese student technology-competition visual language. Every slide needs distinct intentional composition with useful illustrations, not repeated equal card grids or a generic dashboard. Keep text large and legible, with calm dark areas behind copy, fine alignment and generous safe margins. Botanical and technical elements must integrate with lighting rather than floating sticker assets. No source-template tunnel company, unrelated school, financing, patent, awards, fabricated users, watermark, or extra metric. No physical poster/book mockup, no multi-page contact sheet. Render only the specified text, correctly spelled. Treat diagrams as explanatory illustrations. Any future feature must read as future, not completed.
